reply_text:
Dana should keep Tuesday 10 November at 14:30 free. I've sent her that answer in our direct message.

The time comes from her own direct message to me on 14 October. She said her standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Brindle rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 14:30 from then on.

I couldn't confirm it against a calendar: the calendar I can check has nothing for 9–13 November. I told her to check her invite in case the time has changed since October.
